what: served tokens carrying a grave on a syllable that is not the ultima, partitioned by source, edition and by what a repair could be pointed at

NOT_A_REPAIR_RULE.why: the mechanical repair, rewriting the stray varia as an oxia, gives the wrong word on several of the largest forms, and its target is itself attested, so an 'is the target attested' gate does not catch it. Four shapes are published per form and no single target column, deliberately.

counterexamples.ἐπεὶδὴ: ἐπειδὴ: the grave is dropped, not moved

syllable_test: vendored here rather than imported from greek-ocr, so the count cannot change with whether a sibling checkout exists; tests/test_nonfinal_grave.py asserts the two agree

skeleton_class.what: for each flagged form, which clean Greek word has its letters. Grouped on the letter skeleton with every combining mark stripped, counted over the non-OCR corpus only, with a grave on the last nucleus read as an acute because that alternation is positional.
skeleton_class.why_this_and_not_the_four_shapes: the block above is still true: no mechanical reshaping of the accent is right for a majority. That is a fact about those four shapes, not about the class. Asking which word it is decides half the mass and gets every counterexample above right, including that ἐπεὶδὴ is ἐπειδή, where the grave is dropped rather than moved.

base.excludes: OCR sources, and every flagged form, so an illegal form cannot vote on the legal one

page_diffusion.reading: a re-OCR reaches a few percent of this class; it is spread thin, not concentrated on bad pages

skeleton_class.decided_is_a_sample: the 400 largest by flagged tokens, of decided_forms_total. The tranche sheets are emitted from the full list; a sheet built from this sample truncates the pass, which is how the 2026-08-10 third-party apply missed 418 eligible forms.
